quotient_definition: For each three-element subset S of {U,V,A,B}, every parent lift maps to the genus-two curve y^2=product(F in S F/delta_F). Multiplication by an overall rational square does not change the Q-isomorphism class; the probe uses the literal rational polynomial product(F)/product(delta).
purpose: Check the three previously unused triple quotients as well as the selected one. A rank-zero quotient would provide a cheaper complete-Q-point route than the resource-walled selected quotient.
credit: Diagnostic rank classification only. Rank zero is not parent closure until the quotient Q-point set is proved complete and the omitted fourth square condition plus receiver degeneracy are checked exactly.
